question: Which Indian women’s football club won the inaugural SAFF Women’s Club Championship 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**East Bengal FC.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **East Bengal FC became the first Indian women’s club to win an international football title by clinching the inaugural SAFF Women’s Club Championship 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **East Bengal FC defeated host team APF 3–0 in the final.**
 
• **The final was played at Dasrath Stadium, Kathmandu, Nepal.**
 
• **This win marks a historic milestone for Indian women’s football and women’s sports.**
 
• **It is the first international football title for an Indian women’s club.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SAFF Women’s Club Championship** – Regional club-level women’s football tournament organized by the South Asian Football Federation.
 
• **Dasrath Stadium** – Multi-purpose stadium in Kathmandu, Nepal, hosting the championship final.
 
• **APF Club** – Armed Police Force Club, host team defeated in the final.
 
• **International Recognition** – Winning the tournament elevates the status of Indian women’s football globally.
